d: Piazza di Ninfea, with a view far from the city gate. Follow the officers, and Soldati, and Arbate with the heads of the citizens, one of whom carries on a kiss the keys of the city.
Sifare with his follow-up, and Aspasia.
Let's do it with his follow-up.
Temple of Venus with burning plow and adorned with myrtle and roses. Farnace, Aspasia, Soldiers of Farnace around, and Priests near the plow.
Farnace, Aspasia, Sifare, Soldiers of the two princes, and Priests.

Port of the sea, with two fleets anchored in opposite sites of the canal. On one side view of the city of Ninfea. It is approaching the sound of joyful symphony another team of vessels, from the greater of which they land Mitridate, and Ismene, those followed by the Royal Guard, and this by a group of Parties. Arbate with Séguito welcomes him on the shore. Then continue from hand to hand the landing of the Soldatesche, which are being arranged in fine order on the beach.
Sifare, Farnace from the city, and sayings.
Mithridates, Arbates, Royal Guards, and Army deployed.
Mithridates, Royal Guards and Army deployed.
Ismene, and Mithridates with Séguito, who comes to the meeting.

Field of Mitridate. To the right of the theater, and on the front great royal pavilion with seats. Back thick forest, and army deployed etc.Mytridate, Ismene, and Arbate, Royal Guards near the pavilion, and Soldiers parts in the face of the same.
Mithridates, Ismene, Sifare, Farnace, Arbartes, Royal Guards, etc.
Mithridates, Farnace, Sifare, Arbates, et cetera.
Mithridates, Sifares, and so Aspasia, et cetera.
Hanging gardens. Mithridated with Guards, and then Aspasia with the bandages of the real tiara ripped in hand, followed by Ismene.
Interior of tower corresponding to the walls of Ninfea. Chained Farnace, and sitting on a rock.
Martius followed by Romans, and said.

Land atrium, corresponding to a large courtyard in the palace of Nymphea, from which the Roman ships are seen far away, which burn on the sea. In the opening of the scene preceded by his guards, and carried over a kind of cocchio formed by the interweaving of various shields, Mithridated is advanced wounded. They come at his side Sifare, and Arbate, and the remnant of the militias follow him.
Ismene with Farnace, throwing himself at the feet of Mithridates, and sayings.
